# Edge Table Cleaner (edge-table-cleaner)

> 100% local, zero-upload HTML table cleaner and Excel/CSV exporter (Manifest V3 browser extension for Microsoft Edge & Chrome + pure frontend web app) designed for finance, procurement, and government bidding workflows.

## Core Capabilities
- **Complex rowspan/colspan 2D Grid Alignment**: Expands multi-level headers and merged category cells into clean rectangular grids ready for Excel PivotTables and `SUM()` formulas.
- **Financial & Procurement Sanitizer**: Automatically strips currency prefixes/suffixes (`¥`, `$`, `€`, `£`, `元`), removes thousands separators, converts accounting parentheses `(1,250.00)` into negative numbers `-1250.00`, strips footnote markers (`[1]`, `[注2]`, `*`), and preserves leading-zero invoice/account codes (`0038492019`) as text.
- **Multi-Page Longitudinal Merge (Pro)**: Stages tables across paginated intranet ERP/OA portals and merges them vertically while automatically deduplicating repeated headers.
- **Zero-Dependency Local Exports**: Generates genuine Office Open XML `.xlsx`, SpreadsheetML `.xls`, and UTF-8 BOM `.csv` entirely inside the browser.
